conversation_participants_identity_check.name: conversation_participants_identity_check
conversation_participants_identity_check.value: ("conversation_participants"."membership_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conversation_participants"."customer_id" IS NULL) OR ("conversation_participants"."membership_id" IS NULL AND "conversation_participants"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL)

messages_sender_identity_check.name: messages_sender_identity_check
messages_sender_identity_check.value:
(
        ("messages"."sender_type" = 'MEMBERSHIP' AND "messages"."sender_membership_id" IS NOT NULL) OR
        ("messages"."sender_type" = 'CUSTOMER' AND "messages"."sender_customer_id" IS NOT NULL) OR
        ("messages"."sender_type" = 'SYSTEM' AND "messages"."sender_membership_id" IS NULL AND "messages"."sender_customer_id" IS NULL)
      )
